title: Lower weight decay for short training budget
description: Changed WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.1 (halved cautious Muon weight decay), all else unchanged from DEPTH=10 baseline.
reflection: val_bpb 1.003733, worse than baseline 1.002279 — another miss. Five rounds of single-axis perturbations around the DEPTH=10 baseline (depth up, matrix_lr up, matrix_lr down, warmdown ratio up, weight_decay down) have now all failed to beat it, each landing in a similar 1.0037-1.006 band regardless of direction. This is a strong signal that DEPTH=10 with the original LR/WD/schedule values is a genuinely tight local optimum for isolated hyperparameter nudges, and further single-knob sweeps in this neighborhood are unlikely to pay off. Future rounds should consider either a qualitatively different axis (e.g. window pattern, MLP width ratio, batch size/grad-accum tradeoff, embedding LR) or a combination of two previously-tested directions rather than another isolated increment.
